name: El Camino College Dual Enrollment
what_you_do: Take college classes for credit while still in high school.
who_can_apply: Qualified students in grades 9 to 12 who can benefit from college classes. No age rule is listed.
pay_detail: Enrollment fees are waived for dual enrollment students.
deadline_text: Winter Session 2027 (Jan 4 to Feb 4, 2027): registration starts Nov 2, 2026 for college students, and most K-12 students get a registration time on Nov 5, 2026. Spring Semester 2027 (Feb 16 to Jun 12, 2027): registration starts Nov 9, 2026, and most K-12 students get a time on Nov 13, 2026. Summer Term 2027 (Jun 21 to Aug 12, 2027): registration starts May 2027.
how_to_apply: Do the Steps for Dual Enrollment each term you want to register. The steps are listed on a separate page. Call 310-660-3344 or email dualenrollment@elcamino.edu.
notes: Unit limits from the steps page: 11.0 units in Fall 2026 and Spring 2027, and 1 course in Winter 2027. Dual enrollment uses Remind to post updates for students.
